notes.subject: ruaki
notes.rationale: לרוח nĩ ruaki — mũhũmũ/rũhuho, ũtaũrĩtwo 'kĩamba' ta mũgambo ũrĩa wĩhũthagĩragwo, no ruaki nĩrĩo kiugo kĩmwe gĩa Kĩhibirania.

notes.subject: icunjĩ ya gatatũ
notes.rationale: Kuga kwacioukio rĩrĩa gatatũ-rĩ, gatatũ-rĩ, gatatũ-rĩ — kũgawanithia kwa mũhianĩre ũrĩa wonekaga mĩena ĩrĩ ya mbere.

notes.subject: שלשית ... השלשית ... והשלשית
notes.rationale: Kugarũrũka kwa 'gatatũ' marĩa matatũ no kũgawanithia kwa andũ a Yerucarayimu, kwa andũ arĩa methĩtie macio nĩ kũgĩa na mũhianĩre wa kũigua kĩhooto.

notes.subject: סביבותיה
notes.rationale: 'Nthĩro cia waya ũhoro wake' — nĩgetha kũhiũranithia ngero cia waya kũrĩa mũci ũrĩ, ũrĩa waonekaga ta 'mucĩ wayo' hĩndĩ ya kũringithia Yerucarayimu, no Kĩhibirania nĩ kĩuga 'kũrĩa gĩgĩtũĩka nthĩro cia ũhoro wayo'.

translation: Icunjĩ ya gatatũ ũtheretĩrĩre na mũaki hakuhĩ wa mucĩ, rĩrĩa mĩthenya ya kũringithia ĩgĩkũrania; nao ũgĩkũara ⟨את⟩ icunjĩ ya gatatũ, ũmũke ngero nthĩro cia waya ũhoro wake; na icunjĩ ya gatatũ ũciarĩrie kĩamba-inĩ; na ngero nĩngĩcokia thutha wao.
